releases.name: NHL 27
releases.summary: Experience all 32 NHL arenas rebuilt with each team’s energy, traditions, and identity, from goal songs, chants, and signature details to dynamic lighting, jumbotrons, and presentation that reacts to every matchup. A refreshed broadcast package gives every game a cleaner, more modern feel, with new graphics, updated camera work, and sharper on-screen storytelling before puck drop, between whistles, and during highlights.Create a league with friends, manage your roster, and compete head-to-head across a full online season with up to 32 human-controlled teams, flexible settings, schedules, and commissioner tools.Every NHL team plays with true identity through unique playbooks and tendencies, powered by ICE-Q and NHL EDGE data. Matchups feel distinct from puck drop to final horn, with real NHL systems you can study, equip, and use across modes. A new commentary team featuring ESPN play-by-play voice John Buccigross and former NHL goaltender Darren Pang brings fresh perspective, energy, and insight to every game. Updated play-by-play and analysis better capture the speed and emotion of hockey, with more natural reactions, improved flow, and deeper breakdowns that reflect what’s happening on the ice. Build your roster with deeper strategy through the introduction of authentic NHL coaches and playbooks. Coaches add new layers to team-building through unique line combination connections inspired by their real coaching history. [EA Sports]

releases.name: Borderlands 4 - Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort
releases.summary: Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort, featuring the return of the legendary beastmaster from Borderlands 3.

releases.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero / The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Deluxe Edition
releases.summary:
Lloyd Bannings returns to his hometown to follow his late brother's footsteps and join the Crossbell Police Department. However, he finds himself assigned to a ragtag new division called the Special Support Section, which performs odd jobs and helps people in need. 

But he and his new teammates slowly discover that their vibrant city hides a dark criminal underbelly...as well as a few terrible secrets.

releases.name: Drop Dead: The Cabin
releases.summary:
The Cabin is an intense and challenging game. Are you among the few that will survive? 

Gather supplies, arm up, and fight off waves of the walking dead that have escaped from an evil lab experiment. We expect you to die - a lot, each time you fall, you will earn XP to upgrade your character and weapons, making you stronger and bringing you one step closer to beating the game. Whether you play co-op or brave the horrors of hell solo - Fight with a blade, bat or a variety of guns, power up and become a pro monster slayer. 

Can you hold off the horde before they breach the Cabin? Do you have what it takes to survive?

releases.name: Hazard Pay
releases.summary:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process.

Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.

releases.name: Karnov
releases.summary: Recompose hundreds of paintings and climb the rankings in Game Center!Hundreds of paintings :- AUTHOR'S PAINTINGS: Bosch, Botticelli, Brueghel, Canaletto, Caravaggio, Cezanne, Degas, Dürer, Gauguin, Giotto, Goya, Leonardo, Manet, Mantegna, Michelangelo, Monet, Perugino, Piero della Francesca, Raphael, Rembrandt, Renoir, Tiepolo, Tintoretto, Titian, Toulouse-Lautrec, Turner, Van Eyck, Van Gogh, Velazquez, and many others- Paintings of Italian monuments- Photos of various kinds (musical instruments, animals, etc!)Rank Online Game CenterHave Fun

releases.name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline
releases.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

releases.name: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE
releases.summary:
BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

In BrokenLore: DON’T LIE, step into the fragile world of Junko, a young woman attempting to reconnect with Shinji and Hideo, two patients she once met in a rehabilitation center. Confined to her small apartment, she struggles between daily calls, fleeting moments of intimacy, and her own destructive compulsions. Her reliance on medication slowly unravels reality itself, leading her into warped visions and liminal spaces where nothing remains stable.

releases.name: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
releases.summary:
Race beyond the orange track and jump into a Hot Wheels™-sized world with four islands to explore, each with its own vibe and challenges. Roam freely through a world full of adventures, smash obstacles, discover secret items, and take on epic activities.

BECOME THE RUSH MASTER
Each island is ruled by a Rush Master – the ultimate boss to defeat. Complete events to unlock their challenge, and beat them to claim their car and title. Once you've conquered all four, be crowned the one true Rush Master!

PICK YOUR RIDE
Master four unique vehicle types: all-out Versatiles, massive Titans, agile Drifters, and lightning-fast Speeders. Each offers a different way to race. Choose your favorite rides, build your Rush Squad, and get ready for any challenge. And don't stop there: show off by customizing your car, right down to the wheels!

A COLLECTION LIKE NO OTHER
Discover and collect 150+ vehicles through events, activities, and challenges. Unlock rare models, fill your garage, and hit the road with some of the most iconic Hot Wheels™ out there.

MAKE THE WORLD YOUR TRACK
With the new Track Builder, create next-level tracks using the world around you. Attach modules to the ground, build around buildings, or race above the city, weaving around towering skyscrapers.

ENDLESS FUN
Take on a variety of game modes including single-player, split-screen with up to four players, and online multiplayer with full cross-play*. Climb the leaderboards, prove your skills, and race your way to the top!

releases.name: Dumb Ways to Build
releases.summary: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

releases.name: Solvimus
releases.summary: Puzzlide is FREE for a limited time | Brought to you by 3 Magic Shots. Download 3 Magic Shots to get more awesome apps like Puzzlide for FREE. Transform your iPhone in a retro sliding puzzle! Puzzlide put in your hands the wonderful world of Anita Mejía. Complete the puzzles to use them as wallpapers!

releases.name: Nobunaga's Ambition II
releases.summary: If you are looking for a game to play that's fun and strategic, this is better than any other game out there. This addictive Block Smasher brings you the unparalleled feelings you have ever experienced. And it is very easy to play----Just tap your finger, then the blocks will be broken. Boost your fun with breaking more blocks and Multipliers. Break as many as you can to reach higher score. Challenge your friends to beat your highest score. Own the top spot on your daily leader board. Fill your stats to become the ultimate Block Smasher master and earn bragging rights galore. ===================================== How to Play: - Just tap two or more blocks of the same color. - There is no time limit, but each stage has target points to proceed to next stage. ===================================== Tips on Scoring: - Remember just two rules below: 1. The more blocks you break, the more score you get 2. Try to clear all blocks, which brings you a lot bonus. Example of Rule 1 (Formula: Score = Blocks * Blocks * 5) 2 Blocks = 20 3 Blocks = 45... ... Example of Rule 2 (Formula: Bonus = 2000 - Blocks * Blocks * 20) 10 Blocks Left = 0 9 Blocks Left = 380 ... All Blocks Cleared = 2000

releases.name: Farming Life : Agriculture Simulator
releases.summary: Test your knowledge of the hit TV show featuring the adventures of Carrie Bradshaw and friends!Featuring 256 questions in this first version and 10 levels to unlock and complete!

releases.name: Fit Beat Combat
releases.summary: SlotStyle is a 5 reel, multiple-line slot game.With this Slot application you'll experience a real slot machine just like vegas.It also have many slots with different fantastic themes.And you may meet friends who love slots too.Come get this game to try your fortune, enjoy your journey of Dreams.

releases.name: Code Vein II: Mask of Idris
releases.summary:
In Mask of Idris, players are transported into a new, history-altering storyline where multiple timelines and worlds collide.

Forged from countless collapsed timelines, the Forsaken World is unlike anything players have seen before.

At its core lies a massive, swirling convergence of emotions, continuously pulling in fragments from across time and space. This phenomenon is no longer contained and now threatens to spill into the real world.

Exploration in this environment involves both danger and discovery, as players uncover the remnants of forgotten histories.

With new environments, characters, and a deeply immersive storyline, Mask of Idris expands the CODE VEIN II experience beyond its original boundaries.

Players will explore uncharted territories, confront powerful enemies, and unravel a narrative shaped by the collapse of multiple worlds.

releases.name: Detective VR
releases.summary:
DETECTIVE VR is a narrative investigation game for Meta Quest 3 & 3S: You can control time, collect clues and interview witnesses in Passthrough. The investigation takes place in your living room.

Explore unreliable testimonies and confront suspects to find out what happened!

A mix between ObraDinn/Immortality and Minority Report: An innovative way to tell a story in Mixed Reality.

releases.name: Picture Puzzle Girls - Slide & Match
releases.summary: Wild West Video Poker brings the fun of Vegas style 'Jacks or Better' video poker right to your fingertips. The app features actual Jacks or Better payout scale, upgrades, and unlock-able items. You can start earning daily interest, unlock higher stakes, and practice your way to a Video Poker Pro.

releases.name: Earth Must Die
releases.summary: Classic run and jump gameplay with a high speed twist!The force of the wind is a constant obstacle and tool as you solve puzzles on top of a bullet train! Moving against it is difficult, but moving with it grants you a burst of speed! Boxes, switches, and other objects form diabolical puzzles that require a sharp mind and quick reflexes.☆ 45 levels packed with puzzles, switches, boxes, and restarting because of complications due to boxes! With more on the way!☆ A mission for every level!  If you want even more of a challenge, each level has it's own mission that you can try to accomplish!  Some aren't too bad but others have been known to cause ragequits!☆ Responsive Touch Controls!  Touch screen platformer controls are never as good as a controller, but they come very close here! A simple 2 way D-Pad and jump button are all you have to deal with, ensuring that it's simple to hit what you're aiming for.☆ Support for ALL iOS devices!  From the 1st Gen iPod Touch to any iPad you want, you'll be able to play!  iPhone 5 resolution is supported too, so you won't have to stretch your thumbs past the black bars!☆ Time Attack mode!  How fast can you clear all the levels back-to-back?  See if you can get the best time on the leaderboard (aside from the inevitable hackers)!☆ Controller support!  Want to take it to the next level?  Bullet Train Hell features full support for iOS Game Controllers like the iControlPad, complete with remappable buttons so you don't end up having to press start to jump!

releases.name: TORO 2
releases.summary: Toro 2 is a 3D bullfighting simulator where you'll experience the thrill of bullfighting in the world's most famous bullrings in Career Mode. Challenge your friends in fast-paced Versus Mode, where you can choose between the raw power of a fighting bull or the skill and style of a bullfighter.

releases.name: Valheim
releases.summary:
Valheim is a brutal exploration and survival game for 1-10 players set in a procedurally-generated world inspired by Norse mythology. Craft powerful weapons, construct longhouses, and slay mighty foes to prove yourself to Odin!

Explore a world shrouded in mystery. Discover distinct environments with unique enemies to battle, resources to gather and secrets to uncover! Be a viking, sail the open seas in search of lands unknown, and fight bloodthirsty monsters.

Raise viking longhouses and build bases that offer reprieve from the dangers ahead. Customise buildings, both inside and out, with a detailed building system. Progress through building tiers to upgrade, expand and defend your base.

releases.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
releases.summary:
After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war threaten its inhabitants when the new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom have started a war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals, it is the moment of the prophecy, a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace.

A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game. Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea.

releases.name: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD-
releases.summary: Think you’ve got what it takes to win the ultimate jackpot? Step right up and find out! From the black cats to the broken mirrors, this spooky-themed slot game will challenge just how lucky you are. This simple, but elegant, slot machine game features a range of incredibly fun, and unique mini-games that keep the experience fresh. Try Your Luck is perfect for new slot machine gamers, and experienced “slot jockey’s” alike.

releases.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
releases.summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident.The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies.The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

releases.name: Mewgenics
releases.summary:
From the creator of The Binding of Isaac, Super Meat Boy and The End is Nigh comes... Mewgenics! A game where you hoard, breed, train and set cats out on epic adventures through a sprawling world of complete chaos.

Level up your team as you venture further and further from your home, collect unique items, defeat epic bosses, gain mutations and return home so you you can breed and further your bloodline, in this turn based legacy roguelike draft sim about cats!
